_comment: Seedance 2.0 Omni Reference: uses reference images for visual consistency. Images are referenced in the prompt as @image1, @image2, etc. (positional). Note: Seedance Omni does NOT support first_frame — use reference_images instead.

project.name: Throne Room — Seedance Omni Reference
project.description: Anime throne room scene using character and environment reference images

source.prompt: Animate this scene: the warrior @image1 walks through the marble throne room @image2 toward the king @image3 on the golden throne. Dramatic candlelight flickers across the pillars.
The king @image2 raises his hand and speaks from the golden throne in @image1. The warrior @image3 grips his sword hilt. Camera slowly pushes in.
